asleep.text: (Fast asleep. Best not to wake them.)
asleep.speaker: narrator

offer.text: You're the one staying at Nella's. She said you'd be by, or she said I should be by, one of those. You any good with machines?

offer_no.text: Nor me. That's the problem. If you change your mind, the pump's in the orchard.

offer2.text: Orchard pump's dying. Coughs, spits, then nothing. I've hauled buckets from the brook for a week. Ordered a part from the smith weeks back and it never came. Have a look, would you? I keep a ledger at the house if you want the history.

choices.text: I'll see what I can find.
The pin's sheared and the valve leather's gone.

progress2.text: Leather I can understand. Pin's no surprise either. Garrick will make one if you ask him nicely, and if you don't, he'll make one anyway and complain about it.

done.text: I heard it from the house. That sound. Water. You don't know how good that sounds.

choices.text: It should hold for a while.

done2.text: Here. It's not much, but it's honest, and the apples are this year's. Thank you.

variants.text: Pump's still running. Every morning I check, like it's a sick calf.

harvest.text: Wheat's fair. Orchard's good if it gets water. Carrots are carrots.
